name: barbell hang clean high pull
description: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.
instructions: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.
